title: CSUGlobal vs NationalU: control, tuition, size
summary: Colorado State University Global (CSUGlobal) versus National University of Health Sciences (NationalU). Also searched as NationalU vs CSUGlobal. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Colorado State University Global and National University of Health Sciences differ significantly in their institutional characteristics. Colorado State University Global is a public university located in Denver with an undergraduate enrollment of 6,563 students. In contrast, National University of Health Sciences is a private nonprofit institution situated in Lombard, enrolling only 13 undergraduates. Tuition for in-state students at Colorado State University Global is approximately $9,000, whereas National University of Health Sciences does not report in-state tuition rates. These differences highlight the distinct scale, ownership, and geographic settings of the two universities.

CSUGlobal vs NationalU shows a contrast between a large public university and a small private nonprofit college. The substantial difference in undergraduate enrollment reflects their varied educational environments and student populations. Additionally, the presence of in-state tuition at Colorado State University Global contrasts with the absence of such data for National University of Health Sciences, underscoring their differing funding and pricing structures.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: Colorado State University Global and National University of Health Sciences differ notably in their cost structures. Colorado State University Global charges approximately $9,000 for both in-state and out-of-state tuition, reflecting its status as a public institution. In contrast, National University of Health Sciences, a private nonprofit university, does not report specific tuition rates for in-state or out-of-state students. Regarding student debt, the median debt for completers at Colorado State University Global is $25,000, which is double the median debt of $12,500 reported for National University of Health Sciences.

CSUGlobal vs NationalU highlights differences in tuition transparency and student financial outcomes. While Colorado State University Global maintains a uniform tuition rate regardless of residency, National University of Health Sciences lacks publicly available tuition data but shows a lower median debt burden among its graduates. These distinctions reflect their differing institutional types and financial models.

paragraphs: Colorado State University Global and National University of Health Sciences differ in their learning models and campus settings. Colorado State University Global, located in Denver, Colorado, serves a large undergraduate population of 6,563 students, emphasizing online education as a public university. In contrast, National University of Health Sciences is a private nonprofit institution based in Lombard, Illinois, with a much smaller undergraduate enrollment of 13 students, focusing on specialized health sciences programs. CSUGlobal vs NationalU illustrates the contrast between a predominantly online public university with a broad student base and a small private college with a campus-based approach in a different state.

paragraphs: Pick Colorado State University Global if you prefer a public university with a high admission rate and affordable tuition.
